full_judgment: 8. The Court of appeal below has also misread Ext.2, rent receipt and held that it is of 1951. It is absolutely wrong. Ext. 2 and other Exts. namely, 2(a) to 2(e) begins from 1940 to 1955. The Court has also not considered, namely, the evidence of Ext. 7, writ of delivery of possession in Pre-emption Case of 1940 (Misc. Case 182/ 1940). The learned Additional District Judge has also misread the evidence of Ext. 2 series in as much as that the Ext. 2 series the date of the rent receipt began from 1940 and not 1950.
